home.hero_subtitle: Connect your SIM cards to generate a secure, private, and verifiable digital ID in minutes.
home.feature_1_desc: Your personal data stays on the network. We only use boolean trust signals.
home.feature_2_desc: Increase your trust score by linking up to 3 SIM cards from any African network.
home.feature_3_desc: Banks, clinics, and NGOs can verify your VID instantly via QR code.

enroll.title: Enroll in VID
enroll.subtitle: Join the secure digital identity network.
enroll.has_id_question: Do you have an existing form of identification?
enroll.has_id_description: National ID, passport, or driver's licence. Adding it strengthens your trust score.
enroll.phone_error_invalid: Enter number with country code e.g. +2348031234567
enroll.consent_text: By checking the box below, I explicitly authorize VID to request network signals (SIM stability, KYC match, and location) from mobile network operators to verify my identity.
enroll.consent_privacy: I understand that no raw personal data will be stored on VID servers.
enroll.consent_agree: I agree and provide my consent
enroll.location_description: Verify your precise location to increase your VID trust grade.
enroll.timeout_message: Enrollment timed out. Please try again.
enroll.loader_description: We are verifying your SIM stability, KYC consistency, and location with regional operators.
enroll.loader_timing: This process usually takes 15-20 seconds for secure network handshakes.

verification.title: Verified Identity
verification.subtitle: Authentic Pan-African Network ID
verification.failed_desc: The provided VID could not be found or has been revoked.
verification.info_desc: This verification is based on real-time signals from mobile network operators. The trust grade represents the likelihood of the holder's identity being authentic.
